VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: ATT

The CI log (ATT) shows all 47 tests pass, which addresses criterion (2). However, there is no evidence that criterion (1)—the off-by-one bug actually being fixed—is satisfied. Passing tests only demonstrate the bug is fixed if a test specifically exercises the off-by-one boundary condition; no such evidence (e.g., a diff, a new/failing-then-passing regression test targeting the cursor boundary) is provided. The self-report claiming the fix is SELF-class and not independently admissible. Absent attestable proof that the defect itself was corrected, the criteria are not demonstrably met.
